abstract: Choriocarcinoma is a highly aggressive malignant tumor that occurs due to the formation of an abnormal trophoblast. Choriocarcinoma is classified into gestational (GC) and nongestational (NGC) subtypes. The majority of nongestational diseases are limited to ovaries. Extragonadal NGC is a sporadic occurrence and a diagnostic and therapeutic dilemma. Here, we present a young 24-year-old female who presented with a widespread metastatic disease to the brain, bilateral kidneys, lungs, liver, pancreas, and small bowel. She was diagnosed with extragonadal NGC, probably originating from her kidneys. She responded poorly to standard first-, second-, and third-line chemotherapies. Detailed literature analysis with various aspects of pathogenesis, diagnostic criteria, clinical presentation, and treatment options are discussed. There is an unmet need for further research and consensus on many aspects of this rare disease.
abstract_ja: 絨毛癌は異常な栄養膜の形成により生じる非常に攻撃的な悪性腫瘍です。絨毛癌は妊娠性(GC)および非妊娠性(NGC)亜型に分類されます。非妊娠性疾患の大多数は卵巣に限定されています。性腺外NGCは散発的な出来事であり、診断および治療の問題です。ここでは脳、両側腎臓、肺、肝臓、膵臓、および小腸への広範な転移性疾患を伴う24歳若年女性を提示します。彼女はおそらく腎臓に由来する性腺外NGCと診断されました。彼女は標準的な一次、二次、および三次化学療法に対して低い応答を示しました。発生学、診断基準、臨床的呈示、および治療選択を含む様々な側面での詳細な文献分析が論じられています。この稀な疾患の多くの側面についてさらなる研究とコンセンサスのための未解決のニーズがあります。
